method: User-authorized offline one-day schedule shift; no generation or acquisition
limitations: Local clock times, visit identities and order are retained; weekdays change from Saturday/Sunday to Sunday/Monday.
Original 24-25 October Primary/Pair scores do not score the revised dates.
Opening/access, transit departures, weather and other date-bound evidence require new applicability checks.
Proposed transfers retain schedule windows only, without old provider verdicts or verified durations.
Original notes, forecasts, prices, Nearby references and evidence remain in the source itineraries.
